title: Amplifying, Not Learning: The Price of Out-of-Distribution Generalization in AI-Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.21653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI-text detectors gate decisions in education, hiring, and publishing, yet they flag the most fluent, formal human writing as machine-generated: they rate the median formal-native human essay as 99.5% likely AI while clearing genuine high-temperature AI at 10.5%. Deployed detectors share it (chatgpt-detector-roberta flags 56% of formal essays at a 1% false-alarm rate). This is not a calibration bug but the signature of one mechanism: a fine-tuned detector does not learn an AI-versus-human boundary, it amplifies an inherited typicality axis (predictability under a language model) that pre-exists fine-tuning, rescaling it rather than constructing one. Decomposing the detector into this inherited reading and a fine-tuned residual, the inherited part carries the bulk of cross-generator transfer and produces the over-flagging of formal humans, while the residual is generator-specific and does not transfer; a frozen-representation pr

translated_title: 放大而非学习：AI文本检测中分布外泛化的代价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.21653v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：AI文本检测器在教育、招聘和出版领域把关决策，然而它们却将最流畅、正式的人类写作标记为机器生成：它们将中位数正式母语者人类文章评为99.5%可能为AI，同时却将真正的高温AI文本以10.5%的概率放行。部署的检测器存在同样问题（chatgpt-detector-roberta在1%的误报率下将56%的正式文章标记为AI）。这不是校准错误，而是一种机制的特征：微调后的检测器并未学习AI与人类之间的边界，而是放大了一个继承的典型性轴（在语言模型下的可预测性），该轴在微调前就已存在，它只是重新缩放而非构建新边界。将检测器分解为这个继承的读取部分和微调残差部分，继承部分承担了跨生成器迁移的大部分负担，并导致对正式人类文本的过度标记，而残差部分则特定于生成器且不迁移；一个冻结表示的剪枝...
tldr: 本文揭示AI文本检测器并非学习区分AI与人类，而是放大预先存在的语言模型可预测性轴，导致对正式人类写作的过度标记，且跨生成器泛化能力主要来自继承部分而非微调残差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that AI-text detectors do not learn an AI-human boundary but amplify a pre-existing predictability axis under language models, causing over-flagging of formal human writing, with cross-generator generalization driven by inherited components rather than fine-tuned residuals.
